title: Whales
content:
: '''Leviathans''' redirects here. For the leviathans of the earth, see [[46.09]].
Also called '''leviathans'''.

* [[Old Leviathan]] is a figure in the faith of the [[King in Splendour]].

*A sailor outside the Cave of Kull Cove claims to have hunted whales on the [[Ocean of Bitter Regrets]] and sells rancid whalebits. The squid within is terrified of whales and the smell of whales.

*The song of the whales of the Ocean of Bitter Regrets sustains the [[Dreamsong]], and whale foetuses listening to the song learn secrets before they are even born.

*[[Lady Belal]] wants to weave a net so vast it can snare a whale.

*Rogdag hunts bearded whales, among other things. [[35.13]]

*A white whale is trapped in the [[Sunless Sea]], and its agonised cries tarnish the Dreamsong.

*The druids of the Coast ([[02.07]]) cut gigantic didgeridoos that can summon whales from the depths.
